name: Bluerock Acquisition Corp.
summary: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed with the objective of completing various strategic business transactions. These may include mergers, amalgamations, share exchanges, asset acquisitions, stock purchases, reorganizations, or other similar consolidations involving one or more companies or their holdings. The firm was founded on July 11, 2025, and its primary office is located in New York, NY.
